Workflow Scenario: A new support hire needs to find the current refund policy and flag an outdated article.
Evaluation Checklist: Time the first successful search|Check who can publish edits|Identify the owner of each policy

Workflow Scenario: A product team plans a two-week sprint and moves a blocked task into the next cycle.
Evaluation Checklist: Check whether dependencies are visible|Compare how carryover appears in reports|Confirm who can change sprint scope

Workflow Scenario: An editor moves one article through pitch review and publication while coordinating a freelance writer.
Evaluation Checklist: Test a filtered view for each owner|Check what the freelancer can see|Move a deadline and check where it updates

Workflow Scenario: A distributed team runs a 45-minute workshop from idea capture to voting and action items.
Evaluation Checklist: Test guest access before the session|Count the steps from voting to action items|Check what attendees can export

Workflow Scenario: An on-call team opens an incident room and hands over to the next responder.
Evaluation Checklist: Time how long it takes to find the incident owner|Check notification behavior|Find the decision log during handoff

Workflow Scenario: A small operations team reviews overdue tasks and assigns next week's recurring work.
Evaluation Checklist: Check if the team can spot overdue tasks in one view|Test recurring task setup|Confirm that owners receive reminders
